description:
Threadpoint is a Klaviyo Master Platinum Partner redefining how email and SMS drive growth for ecommerce brands. They are seeking an Email Marketing Strategist to manage end-to-end email and SMS strategies for DTC clients, focusing on lifecycle programs and performance analysis to enhance customer retention.

Develop and execute email & SMS marketing strategies across multiple ecommerce client accounts

Build, optimize, and manage Klaviyo flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment, sunset, and more)

Plan and execute campaign calendars aligned with client goals, promotions, and seasonal moments

Own segmentation strategy, building smart, behavior-based segments that drive relevance and revenue

Analyze campaign and flow performance, pull insights, and present actionable recommendations to clients

Manage A/B testing programs to continuously improve open rates, click rates, and conversion

Collaborate with designers to brief and review email creative that's on-brand and conversion-focused

Monitor deliverability health, list hygiene, and sender reputation

Contribute to client strategy calls and reporting with a data-informed, ownership mindset

They are seeking an Email Marketing Strategist to manage end-to-end email and SMS strategies for DTC clients, focusing on lifecycle programs and performance analysis to enhance customer retention.

mustHave: 2+ years of hands-on email marketing experience, ideally in an agency or multi-brand environment
Strong Klaviyo proficiency: flows, segments, campaigns, reporting, and deliverability
Deep understanding of ecommerce/DTC customer lifecycle and retention marketing
Experience with SMS marketing strategy and execution (Klaviyo SMS, Postscript, or Attentive)
Analytical mindset, comfortable pulling data, interpreting metrics, and turning numbers into strategy
Strong copywriting instincts. You know what makes someone open, click, and buy
Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platforms
Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, small-team environment
preferredHave: Experience with ecommerce brands doing $1M to $50M+ in annual revenue
Background in conversion rate optimization or customer retention analytics
Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, Triple Whale, or Northbeam
Previous agency experience managing multiple accounts simultaneously
